ayahLayers.grammar: A coordinated verbal clause: وَ links this final clause to the preceding description; يَمْنَعُونَ is a present-tense verb with an explicit masculine-plural subject marker, and ٱلْمَاعُونَ is its definite accusative object.
ayahLayers.contextualMeaning: And they withhold ordinary acts of help—the small, useful things people lend or do for one another.
sentenceMap: وَيَمْنَعُونَ — coordinated verb phrase: and they withhold
ٱلْمَاعُونَ — definite direct object: the ordinary aid or small kindnesses

teaching.type: present-tense verb with attached conjunction and subject marker
teaching.rootPicture: The root conveys holding something back or preventing access.
teaching.construction: وَ (and) + يَمْنَعُ (he withholds or prevents) + ونَ (they, masculine plural).
teaching.grammar: Form I imperfect verb, third-person masculine plural, active and indicative; the واو الجماعة is the explicit subject marker.
teaching.sentenceRole: The coordinated predicate continuing the description of the heedless people; its subject is the masculine plural group understood from the preceding context.
teaching.recognitionClue: A present verb ending in ـونَ commonly signals a third-person masculine plural subject, while وَ at the front means ‘and.’

forms.meaning: basic verb stem: to withhold or prevent
forms.difference: The root meaning is expressed directly in the basic stem without a derived-pattern prefix.

teaching.takeaway: Recognize وَيَمْنَعُونَ as ‘and they withhold’: وَ joins the clause, and ـونَ identifies ‘they.’

layers.occurrenceRole: Coordinated verb phrase; the subject is the masculine plural people described in the preceding verses.

morphology.notes: The initial وَ is a coordinating conjunction; the final ونَ carries the masculine-plural subject marking in this present-tense form.

layers.grammar: A coordinated active imperfect verb in the third-person masculine plural; وَ connects it to the preceding clause and the attached plural marker supplies the subject.
learnerConnections: وَ commonly joins a new action or description to what came before.
The ending ـونَ is a strong recognition clue for a third-person masculine plural present verb.

pedagogy.recognitionClue: Look for وَ at the beginning for ‘and’ and ـونَ at the end for ‘they’ in a present-tense verb.
pedagogy.explanation: The stem يَمْنَعُ means ‘he withholds or prevents’; adding the masculine-plural ending changes the subject to ‘they,’ and وَ links the action to the previous description.
pedagogy.takeaway: وَيَمْنَعُونَ = وَ + يَمْنَعُ + ونَ: and + withholds + they.

teaching.meaning: the ordinary aid or small kindnesses
teaching.rootPicture: The lexical root is associated with benefit or assistance; here the noun points to ordinary helpful things.
teaching.construction: ٱلْ (the) + مَاعُونَ (ordinary aid or small helpful necessities).
teaching.grammar: A definite noun in the accusative case, functioning as the direct object of يَمْنَعُونَ; the final ـَ reflects the accusative ending in this fully vocalized occurrence.
teaching.sentenceRole: Definite direct object: it names the aid or small helpful things that they withhold.
teaching.recognitionClue: ٱلْ at the beginning marks the noun as definite, ‘the’; the final ـَ is consistent with its object role here.
teaching.takeaway: ٱلْمَاعُونَ is ‘the ordinary aid’: identify ٱلْ as ‘the’ and let the clause show that this is what they withhold.

layers.occurrenceRole: Definite direct object of يَمْنَعُونَ; it names the ordinary aid or small helpful things being withheld.

morphology.notes: The noun is read here in its Qur'anic context as ordinary aid or small helpful necessities; its broader lexical range should remain visible during review.

layers.grammar: Definite accusative noun serving as the direct object of يَمْنَعُونَ.
layers.meaning: the ordinary aid or small kindnesses
learnerConnections: The lexical meaning of الماعون is broader than one English noun; in this context it can be learned as ordinary aid or small helpful necessities.

pedagogy.recognitionClue: Spot ٱلْ at the front as the definite article ‘the’; the noun follows it as one lexical unit.
pedagogy.explanation: The word names useful, ordinary assistance or small things people help one another with. In the sentence it is the object of ‘they withhold.’
pedagogy.takeaway: ٱلْمَاعُونَ = the ordinary aid; its role becomes clear because it follows the verb ‘they withhold.’
